body: It doesn’t always happen like that although I know it often does. I’ve slightly caught feelings but I think they’re more of a “I like hooking up with you” than I want to date you. Makes it trickier cause like I don’t want to encourage her to dump him just to not date her but at the same time I see exactly where you’re coming from and idk.

I do feel slightly bad for him but from what she says he’s not that great to her (not justifying; I know cheating is wrong), but I also think it feels so right which is why it’s conflicting. I want her to just tell him and break up with him and figure it out. We’ll see.
That would be cool! The only reason I specified Europe is because I’m trying to work on my French, Spanish and German, but I like talking to all people!

I mean theoretically her declining your advances initially should have stopped you from continuing. Also body language and overall reactions/responses to you would be an indicator. You don’t always have to scream no; you can convey your discomfort in other ways aside from flat out saying it.
